key_insight: A curvilinear D3Q27 cumulant lattice-Boltzmann method retains exact one-to-one streaming on smoothly warped grids without advection interpolation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports flow simulation in deformed geometries and moving-boundary systems while maintaining conservative transport.
method: Encode local geometry through a metric-Gaussian equilibrium and a Christoffel-connection source in moment space.
Reconstruct homogeneous-state perturbation streaming to preserve uniform physical states on warped meshes.
Combine D3Q27 cumulant collision with boundary-compatible ALE and two-way fluid–structure interaction extensions.
evidence_signal: Warped-grid shear-wave, Taylor–Green, and ABC-flow tests assess bulk dynamics and report round-off mass and momentum conservation in periodic cases; Poiseuille, peristaltic-pumping, and FSI demonstrations assess boundary extensions.
watch_item: Validation concerns smoothly deformed grids; robustness under severe mesh distortion and broader turbulent-flow conditions is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Local Metrics for Exact Streaming on Curvilinear Lattices: A Curvilinear D3Q27 Cumulant Lattice-Boltzmann Method
